site.name: Sketchpad Arcade
site.headline: Games drawn in a sketchbook
site.intro: Free puzzle and arcade games that look like a kid drew them in pencil. No downloads, no sign-ups, and nothing you wouldn't want your kids to see.
site.description: Free, family-friendly browser games drawn in a hand-sketched pencil style. Play on a phone, tablet or computer with no downloads and no sign-ups.
site.contact_text: Questions, feedback or business inquiries? Email us at hello@sketchpadarcade.com.

also.text: Like these in full colour? The painted originals live at Beach Day Arcade.

games.name: Margin Merge
games.tagline: Drop sea friends in the tank and merge matching pairs, all the way up to a dolphin.
games.meta: Play Margin Merge free online. Drop sand dollars, shells, crabs and more into a glass tank, merge matching pairs into bigger sea friends and try to make a dolphin. Works on phone and computer.
games.lead: A relaxing merge puzzle in a sunny glass tank. Drop sea friends from the top, and when two of the same kind touch, they merge into the next one up. Climb from a tiny sand dollar all the way to a dolphin, but don't let the tank overflow.
how: Move to aim, then let go to drop a sea friend into the tank.
When two of the same kind touch, they merge into the next sea friend and you score points.
Merges climb from Sand Dollar to Moon Snail, Scallop, Starfish, Crab, Clownfish, Pufferfish, Jellyfish, Octopus, Sea Turtle and Dolphin.
Two dolphins swim off together for a 100 point bonus.
The game ends when the stack stays above the dotted line at the top of the tank.
controls: Drag or move your mouse to aim, then release or click to drop. On a keyboard, use the arrow keys and Space.
Pop removes one sea friend of your choice. You start with one and earn another every 500 points.
New game starts over, and the Sound button turns sound effects on or off.
tips: Keep small sea friends together and big ones along the bottom or sides.
Check the Next window before you drop so you can plan where the following piece will go.
A merge can bump into a matching neighbor and set off a combo, so line up chains when you can.
Save your Pop for a small piece stuck between two big ones.

games.name: 2048 DROP
games.title: 2048 DROP – Free Number Merge Game | Sketchpad Arcade
games.tagline: Drop numbers, merge matching balls and work your way to 2048.
games.meta: Drop numbers, combine matching balls, and work your way toward 2048. How high can you merge before the container fills?
games.lead: A number-merging physics puzzle in a sea-glass jar. Drop numbered balls, watch them roll and settle, and merge matching numbers into bigger ones: 2 and 2 make 4, 4 and 4 make 8, all the way up to 2048 and beyond. Keep the pile below the danger line to stay in the game.
facts: Saves your best and daily scores
how: Move your mouse or drag your finger to slide the waiting ball left and right above the jar.
Click, or let go of the screen, to drop it. Gravity takes over, and the ball rolls and settles on the pile.
When two balls with the same number touch, they merge into one ball worth double. Merges can set off chain reactions.
Every merge scores the value of the new ball, and chain merges earn a bonus. Bigger merges are worth far more.
Keep the pile below the dashed red danger line. If a ball sits above it for about two and a half seconds, the game ends.
controls: Computer: move the mouse to aim and click to drop. Arrow keys aim and Space drops.
Phone and tablet: drag to aim and lift your finger to drop.
NEXT shows the ball you'll drop next, plus a smaller preview of the one after it. The Sound button turns effects on or off.
tips: Keep your biggest numbers together in one corner so they can merge with each other as they grow.
Check NEXT before every drop and leave a spot for it beside a matching number.
Avoid stranding small balls between big ones. A lonely 2 at the bottom can block a whole column.
Keep open space in the middle of the jar so new balls have room to land and roll.
Chain merges score extra, so line up pairs that will set each other off.
A ball crossing the danger line for a moment is fine. Watch the countdown and clear the top before it runs out.
about: 2048 DROP is an original number-merging physics game made by Sketchpad Arcade. It mixes the satisfying doubling of a number puzzle with balls that fall, roll and bounce, so every drop changes the whole pile.

Reaching 2048 is a big moment, but it isn't the end. Skilled players can keep merging to 4096 and beyond. Your personal best, today's best and lifetime stats are saved on your device. No account needed.

games.name: Scribble Swing
games.tagline: Grab pearls with a stretchy tentacle and swing a little octopus over the sea.
games.meta: Play Scribble Swing free online. Hold to grab glowing pearls with a stretchy tentacle, swing high and let go to fling a little octopus across the sea. Grab starfish, bounce on beach balls and see how far you can go. Works on phone and computer.
games.lead: A one-button swinging game starring Ollie, a very bouncy octopus. Hold to grab the nearest pearl with a tentacle, swing down and up, then let go to fling forward. Catch the next pearl before you drop into the sea, collect starfish along the way and see how far you can swing.
how: Press and hold to grab the nearest pearl with a tentacle. The dashed ring shows which pearl you'll grab.
Swing down and back up, then let go to fling forward through the air.
Hold again to catch the next pearl. If Ollie drops into the sea, the game is over.
Your score is the distance you swing plus 5 points for every starfish.
The farther you go, the farther apart the pearls get. Pink pearls bob up and down, and bubble pearls pop soon after you grab them.
controls: Press and hold anywhere on the playfield to grab, and let go to fling. On a keyboard, hold Space or the Up arrow.
Bounce off the beach balls floating on the sea for a free boost.
The Sound button turns sound on or off.
tips: Let go just after Ollie passes under the pearl and starts to rise. That gives the biggest fling.
Letting go too late sends you straight up. Letting go too early sends you down toward the water.
Starfish follow the swing paths, so a nice smooth swing usually scoops them up.
On a bubble pearl, swing once and let go fast before it pops.

games.name: Note Quest
games.tagline: Guess the secret word in the bottle in six tries, with colour clues after every guess.
games.meta: Play Note Quest free online. A secret word washes up in every bottle. Guess it using green and yellow letter clues, with Beginner, Intermediate and Advanced difficulty. Works on phone and computer.
games.lead: A friendly word-guessing game on the beach. Every bottle that washes ashore hides a secret word. Type a guess and the letters light up to show which ones are right. Solve bottle after bottle as the words grow from 4 letters to 6, and see how many you can find before you run out of shells.
how: Pick Beginner, Intermediate or Advanced, then type a real word and press Enter.
After each guess the letters change colour. Green means the letter is in the right spot. Yellow means it's in the word but in a different spot. Grey means it isn't in the word.
Solve in fewer guesses for more points, and solve bottles in a row for a streak bonus.
Miss a word and you lose one of your 3 shells. Solve words in a row to win a shell back.
Beginner has 4 and 5-letter words, 7 tries and 2 hints. Intermediate grows from 4 to 6 letters with 6 tries and 1 hint. Advanced has 5 and 6-letter words, 5 tries and no hints.
controls: Tap the letters on the on-screen keyboard, or type on your computer keyboard.
Enter checks your guess and the delete key removes a letter.
Hint shows you one letter of the secret word for half points. Beginner gets 2 hints per bottle, Intermediate 1, Advanced none.
tips: Start with a word that uses lots of different common letters, like a word with A, E and S in it.
Grey keys on the keyboard are letters you can skip.
A yellow letter is in the word, so try it in a new spot on your next guess.
Save your hint for when you're down to your last couple of tries.

games.name: Eraser Gulp
games.tagline: Steer a hungry little whirlpool and gulp up the beach to grow.
games.meta: Play Eraser Gulp free online. Steer a cute magic whirlpool around a busy beach, gulp down shells, buckets, umbrellas and even boats, and grow big enough to reach the next beach before time runs out. Works on phone and computer.
games.lead: A swirly arcade game starring a very hungry little whirlpool. Glide around a busy beach and gulp down anything smaller than you. Start with shells and starfish, grow big enough for buckets and beach balls, then umbrellas, sandcastles, boats and beach huts. Fill the size meter before the clock runs out to reach the next, bigger beach.
how: Steer your whirlpool around the beach.
Glide over things smaller than you to gulp them down. Every gulp makes you a little bigger.
Things that are too big get a red ring when you touch them. Come back when you've grown.
Fill the size meter before the timer runs out to clear the level. Time left over becomes bonus points.
Each new beach is bigger, with a bigger size goal.
controls: On a phone or tablet, drag your finger and the whirlpool follows it.
With a mouse, move the pointer over the beach and the whirlpool swirls toward it.
On a keyboard, use the arrow keys or W, A, S and D.
The Sound button turns sound on or off.
tips: Gulp lots of little things at the start. They add up fast.
Umbrella camps have towels, coolers, buckets and balls all close together. Swirl around them for a quick feast.
Big things are worth lots of points, so head for them as soon as they fit.
A banner tells you when a new kind of thing fits, so watch for it.

games.name: Sidewalk Hop
games.tagline: Hop a little crab across busy boardwalks and splashy water.
games.meta: Play Sidewalk Hop free online. Help Crabby hop up the beach, step sideways or back to dodge traffic, dodge bikes and beach carts on the boardwalk, ride surfboards, rafts and tubes across the water and stay ahead of the tide. Grab shells for bonus points. Works on phone and computer.
games.lead: An endless hopping game starring Crabby, a small crab with big plans. Hop forward one step at a time, dodge the bikes and beach carts on the boardwalks, and ride surfboards, rafts and tubes across the water. Keep moving, because the tide is coming in behind you. Grab shells for bonus points and see how far you can go.
how: Hop forward, left, right or back with the arrow buttons under the beach. Step sideways or back to dodge traffic and get out of trouble.
Bikes and beach carts zoom along the boardwalks. Wait for a gap, then hop.
Cross the water by hopping onto surfboards, rafts and tubes. Hopping into the water ends the game.
Floats drift along, so hop off before Crabby rides off the edge.
The tide creeps in from behind. If it catches up, the game is over.
You score 1 point for every row forward and 5 points for every shell.
controls: Tap the arrow buttons under the beach to hop forward, left, right or back.
You can also tap the beach to hop forward, or swipe in any direction.
On a keyboard, use the arrow keys or W, A, S and D. Space also hops forward.
The Sound button turns sound on or off.
tips: You can hop sideways on a boardwalk or a float to line up a safer path.
Long rafts are the easiest to land on. Little tubes need good timing.
Umbrellas, sandcastles, rocks and palm trees block the way, so plan around them.
Don't wait too long. A few quick hops keep you well ahead of the tide.

games.name: Paper Gates
games.tagline: Slide jelly blocks out through the gates that match their colour.
games.meta: Play Paper Gates free online. Drag cute jelly blocks around a boardwalk board and slide each one out through the gate of the same colour. Clear every block before time runs out. New boards every level. Works on phone and computer.
games.lead: A sliding block puzzle on a sunny boardwalk. The board is packed with cute jelly blocks, and the edges have coloured gates. Drag each block around the others and slide it into the gate that matches its colour to send it whooshing out to sea. Clear the whole board before time runs out. Every level is a brand new board, and they get bigger as you go.
how: Drag a block to slide it. Blocks move around each other but can't overlap.
Slide a block into a gate of the same colour and it leaves the board.
A block only fits through a gate that is at least as wide as the block.
Clear every block before the timer runs out. Time left over becomes bonus points.
Run out of time and you lose a shell and get a new board. Lose all 3 shells and the game is over.
controls: Press on a block and drag. It slides straight toward your finger, one square at a time, and stops when something is in the way.
Works with a finger on a phone or tablet and with a mouse on a computer.
The Sound button turns sound on or off.
tips: Look for blocks that already have a clear path to their gate and send them out first.
Clearing one block often opens up room for the ones behind it.
Long blocks need wide gates, so check the gate sizes before you start sliding.
Every board can be solved, so if you feel stuck, try moving a different block out of the way.

games.name: Doodle Stacks
games.tagline: Stack shiny sea-glass shells by colour and pop them in tens.
games.meta: Play Doodle Stacks free online. Drag stacks of shiny sea-glass shells onto a sunny hexagon sandbar. Stacks with the same top colour hop together, and 10 of a colour pop for points. Chain pops for combos. New colours every level. Works on phone and computer.
games.lead: A colour sorting puzzle on a little hexagon sandbar. Three stacks of shiny sea-glass shells wait in the driftwood tray. Drag one onto an empty spot and any neighbours with the same top colour hop across, one shell at a time. Get 10 or more of one colour on top and they pop in a splash of points. Pop enough shells to finish the level, but don't let the sandbar fill up. Every level adds a new colour, and later ones have rocks in the way.
how: Drag a stack from the tray onto any empty spot on the sandbar.
Stacks next to each other with the same top colour hop together onto one stack.
When 10 or more shells of one colour sit on top of a stack, they pop for points.
One pop can set off another. Chains score combo points.
Pop enough shells to finish the level. If the sandbar fills up, the game is over.
controls: Press on a stack in the tray and drag it onto the sandbar. You can also tap a stack and then tap an empty spot.
Works with a finger on a phone or tablet and with a mouse on a computer.
On a keyboard, press 1, 2 or 3 to pick a stack, move with the arrow keys and press Enter to drop it. W uses the Wave.
The Wave button washes one stack off the sandbar, once per level.
The Sound button turns sound on or off.
tips: Keep each colour in its own corner of the sandbar so stacks can grow tall.
Look under the top colour. When it hops away, the colour below might match a neighbour and start a chain.
Save the Wave for when the sandbar is nearly full.
Don't fill every spot. An empty spot or two gives you room to move.

games.name: Scribble Slice
games.tagline: Swipe to slice the tropical fruit that splashes up out of the waves.
games.meta: Play Scribble Slice free online. Juicy watermelons, pineapples, mangoes and more splash up out of the sea. Swipe to slice them, chain combos and dodge the spiky sea urchins. Works on phone and computer.
games.lead: A juicy slicing game on a sunny beach. Watermelons, pineapples, coconuts, mangoes, kiwis and more come splashing up out of the waves. Swipe across them to slice them in half with a big splash of juice. Slice a few in one swipe for a combo bonus, but steer clear of the spiky sea urchins. The fruit comes faster and in bigger bunches the longer you last.
how: Fruit splashes up out of the sea at the bottom of the beach.
Swipe across a fruit to slice it and score 10 points.
Slice two or more fruit in one swipe for a combo bonus.
Swiping a spiky sea urchin costs a shell, and so does letting a fruit fall back into the sea.
Lose all 3 shells and the game is over. Every 500 points gives you a lost shell back.
controls: Press and drag your finger across the screen to slice. With a mouse, hold the button down and drag.
Works with a finger on a phone or tablet and with a mouse on a computer.
Press Enter or Space to start a new game.
The Sound button turns sound on or off.
tips: Wait for the fruit to rise to the top of its jump, where it moves slowest, then slice.
Long sweeping swipes through a bunch of fruit score big combos.
Swipe around the sea urchins, not through them. Lift your finger if one is in the way.
Golden starfruit is worth 50 points, and a beach ball slows everything down for a few seconds.

games.name: Sketch Search
games.tagline: Find the hidden beach words in a board of sandy letter tiles.
games.meta: Play Sketch Search free online. A beach word search with Beginner, Intermediate and Advanced levels and a new theme every round, from seashells and sandcastles to boardwalk snacks. Drag across the sandy letter tiles to find every hidden word before time runs out. Works on phone and computer.
games.lead: A sunny word search on the shore. Every level has a beach theme, like Seashells, Boats or Island Fruits, and a list of words hidden in a board of sandy letter tiles. Drag across a word from its first letter to its last and it lights up in a bright colour and gets crossed off your list. Find them all before time runs out. The boards get bigger as you go, and the words start hiding on a slant and even backwards.
how: Pick Beginner, Intermediate or Advanced. Each one keeps its own best score.
Each level has a beach theme and a list of words to find.
Drag in a straight line from the first letter of a word to its last letter.

Beginner words only go across and down, with small boards and plenty of time. Intermediate adds slanted words, then backwards ones. Advanced has big boards with words hiding in every direction from the start, a tighter clock and double points.
Longer words score more, quick finds earn a bonus, and time left over is added at the end of the level.
Run out of time and you lose a shell and get a fresh puzzle. Lose all 3 shells and the game is over.
controls: Press on the first letter of a word and drag to the last letter, then let go.
Works with a finger on a phone or tablet and with a mouse on a computer.
Tap Hint (or press H) to flash the first letter of a word you haven't found.
The Sound button turns sound on or off.
tips: Look for unusual letters like K, Y, W or Z first. They are easy to spot and often start a word.
Find the longest words early, while the board is still full of letters to check.
Find words quickly one after another for bonus points.
You get one extra hint for every level you clear, so don't be afraid to use them.

games.name: Pencil Putt
games.tagline: Pull back, aim and putt your way round a sunny tiki beach mini golf course.
games.meta: Play Pencil Putt free online. A beach mini golf game seen from above. Pull back to aim, let go to putt, and sink the ball past sand traps, water, the tide, bouncy beach balls, a scuttling crab and a spinning umbrella. 36 holes, then an endless Back Nine Tour. Works on phone and computer.
games.lead: A mini golf game on a tropical beach, seen from above. Each hole is a patch of green turf on the sand, with driftwood walls, rocks and tiki torches all around. Pull back like a slingshot to aim, let go to putt, and try to sink the ball in as few strokes as you can. Watch out for sand traps, water, the tide, bouncy beach balls, a busy crab, a spinning beach umbrella and a sliding surfboard gate. Play all 36 holes, then keep going on the Back Nine Tour, where everything moves faster.
how: Press anywhere on the course and pull back. The dotted line shows where the ball will go.
Pull further for a harder putt, then let go to hit the ball.
Sink the ball in the cup. Beat the par for big points, and a hole in one is worth 1000.
Sand slows the ball, the tide and slopes push it, beach balls bounce it and water costs a stroke.
Finish a hole over par and you lose a shell. Lose all 3 shells and the game is over.
controls: Press anywhere, pull back to aim and set the power, then let go to putt.
Works with a finger on a phone or tablet and with a mouse on a computer.
On a keyboard, the left and right arrows aim, up and down set the power and Space putts.
The Sound button turns sound on or off.
tips: A soft putt that stops near the cup is often better than a big whack. A fast ball can roll right over the hole.
Use the walls! A bank shot off the driftwood is often the only way round a corner.
Wait for the crab and the spinning umbrella to move out of the way before you putt.
A hole in one wins back a lost shell, so it is worth going for it on the short holes.

games.name: Letter Links
games.tagline: Link words around a chalk path in the park and turn all twelve letters gold. Three difficulties.
games.meta: Play Letter Links free online. Tap chalk letters around a path in the park to make linked words, use all twelve letters in as few words as you can, and beat par. Beginner, Intermediate and Advanced. Works on phone and computer.
games.lead: Twelve chalk letters sit around a path in the park, three on each side. Spell words by hopping from side to side, and each new word starts with the last letter of the one before. Turn every letter gold to solve the puzzle, and do it in par or fewer words for big bonus points. There are 72 puzzles, from easy warm-ups to tricky ones with J, Q and Z. Pick Beginner for easy letters and extra words, Intermediate for the full run, or Advanced for the trickiest puzzles with 4-letter-minimum words and double points.
facts: Saves your best score and progress
how: Tap letters around the path to spell a word. Each next letter must come from a different side.
Press Enter to play the word. Your next word starts with its last letter.
Letters can be used again. Used letters turn gold.
Turn all 12 letters gold to solve the puzzle. Try to do it in the par number of words.
Beginner: easy letters, 7 words per puzzle and 4 hints. Intermediate: all 72 puzzles, 6 words, points ×1.5. Advanced: tricky letters, 4+ letter words only, 5 words, points ×2.
You have 3 heart lives. Running out of words or skipping costs a heart.
Each difficulty saves its own progress and best score. Change it from the start screen, the ? card or the game-over card.
controls: Computer: click or drag across letters, or type them on the keyboard. Enter plays the word and Backspace deletes a letter.
Phone or tablet: tap letters or slide your finger from letter to letter, then tap Enter.
Hint shows the next letter of a good solution. Restart clears your words for this puzzle.
The sound button turns the sound effects on or off.
tips: Long words that use letters from all four sides get you there fastest.
Think about the last letter: a word ending in a common letter like S, E or T gives you more choices next.
Deleting the first letter of a word takes back your previous word, so you can try another path.
Save hints for the hard puzzles. You earn a new hint bulb every three puzzles you solve.
Under par pays the most: each word you save is worth 150 bonus points.

games.name: Sketch Sprint
games.tagline: Race a twisting sketchbook path through downtown, the backyard, the park, the creek and the woods. Swipe to turn, jump and slide.
games.meta: Play Sketch Sprint free online, a fast endless runner drawn in pencil. Pick Francis, Clare, George, Joan or one of four more kids and race a path that turns sharp corners through downtown, a backyard, the park, a creek and the woods. Swipe to turn, jump gaps, slide under nets and grab gold stars. Works on phone and computer.
games.lead: A fast endless runner with sharp corners, drawn like a page from a sketchbook. Pick your runner from eight kids, then race a path that twists left and right through five places: downtown, the backyard, the park, a creek and the woods. Swipe the way the arrow points to take each corner, jump logs and gaps, slide under nets and branches, and grab gold stars for points. Catch a paper plane to fly, a magnet to pull stars in, a bubble that saves you once, or a skateboard to zoom through anything. Every 500 meters a new wave starts: faster, with a bigger multiplier. Stars you collect add up between runs and unlock new runners.
how: Your runner races down the path on their own and gets faster the longer you last.
The path turns 90 degrees left and right. An arrow sign and a rail mark each corner: swipe that way just before you reach it. Miss it and you run into the rail.
Change lanes to get around walls, hot dog carts, lookout towers and fallen trees. Tall walls block a whole lane, so go around them.
Jump over low things like logs, sandbox castles and ducks, and over gaps in the path. Slide under branches, picnic blankets and nets.
Grab gold stars for 10 points each. You also score for every meter you run and a bonus for every corner.
Bump into something head on and the run is over. Bump the side of something and you stumble, but a second stumble soon after ends the run.
Every 500 meters is a new wave: faster, with a bigger score multiplier. Stars add up between runs: Clare unlocks at 150, George at 400, Joan at 800, then John, Catherine, Joseph and Thérèse.
controls: Computer: use the arrow keys or A and D to change lanes and turn corners, Up, W or Space to jump, and Down or S to slide. You can also drag with the mouse.
Phone or tablet: swipe left or right to change lanes, swipe up to jump and swipe down to slide.
Press P or Esc, or tap the pause button, to take a break.
The sound button turns sound on or off.
tips: Look ahead, not at your runner. Big things in the distance give you lots of time to pick a lane.
Swipe down while you're in the air to drop fast, then slide straight under the next net.
Wait until you're past something before you switch lanes, or you'll bump its side.
A paper plane lets you fly over everything and grab a line of stars in the sky.
A magnet pulls stars to you, and a bubble saves you from one bump.

games.name: Doodle Drop
games.tagline: Spin a giant pencil and drop a bouncy striped ball down to the pencil cup.
games.meta: Play Doodle Drop free online. Spin a giant pencil to line up gaps, bounce a striped ball down ring by ring, dodge pink scribbles and ink blots, and land in the pencil cup. Works on phone and computer.
games.lead: A bouncy striped ball sits at the top of a giant pencil, and the only way down is through the gaps in the paper rings around it. Drag to spin the pencil, drop through ring after ring, and steer clear of the spiky pink scribbles and sliding ink blots. Fall through three in a row and your ball glows with a rainbow that smashes right through the next ring.
how: The striped ball bounces up and down on its own.
Drag left or right to spin the pencil and turn a gap under the ball.
Drop through each ring to score. More rings in a row score more.
Don't land on the pink scribbles or the sliding purple ink blots.
Fall through three rings without bouncing to glow, then smash the next ring to bits.
Land in the pencil cup at the bottom to clear the level and climb a taller pencil.
controls: Computer: drag with the mouse, or hold the arrow keys or A and D to spin the pencil. Press Esc to pause.
Phone or tablet: drag left and right anywhere on the pencil.
The sound button turns the sound effects on or off.
tips: Start turning while the ball is still in the air so the gap is ready when it lands.
Little nudges work better than big swipes. The pencil keeps spinning a bit after you let go.
Chain drops together for big points and a rainbow smash that even breaks scribbles.
Watch the ink blots slide before you land near them.
If you pop, Retry starts the same level again with the score you had when it began.

games.name: Pencil Plunk
games.tagline: Pull thumbtacks out of popsicle sticks on a corkboard and sort them into paper cups.
games.meta: Play Pencil Plunk free online. Pull colorful thumbtacks out of popsicle sticks pinned to a corkboard, fill paper cups by color and plunk every stick onto the desk. Works on phone and computer.
games.lead: A pin-pulling puzzle on a corkboard. Popsicle sticks are pinned to the board with bright thumbtacks. Tap a tack that no stick is lying on and it pops out and flies into the paper cup of its color. Tacks with no cup wait in the pencil case, so plan ahead before it fills up. Pull the last tack from a stick and it plunks onto the desk, while a little ink-drop buddy cheers you on.
how: Tap a thumbtack that no popsicle stick is lying on. Tacks under a stick look darker and can't be pulled yet.
The tack flies into the paper cup of the same color. Three tacks fill a cup, and the next cup drops in.
If no cup wants that color, the tack waits in the pencil case. A new cup scoops up its color from there.
A stick with one tack left swings down, and it can cover other tacks. Pull its last tack and it plunks onto the desk.
Clear every stick to finish the level. If the pencil case is full and no tack fits a cup, the game is over.
controls: Phone or tablet: tap a tack to pull it.
Computer: click a tack. On a keyboard, the arrow keys pick a free tack, Enter or Space pulls it, and + adds a slot.
The +1 slot button adds a sixth spot to the pencil case, once per level. Restart level tries the level again.
The sound button turns sound on or off.
tips: Pull tacks that match a waiting cup first. They don't use up pencil case space.
Check the Next note at the top to see which cup colors are coming.
Look before you pull a stick's second-to-last tack. It will swing down and may cover tacks below it.
Every cup shows its tack's symbol, so you can match by shape as well as color.
Save +1 slot for when the pencil case is almost full.

games.name: Draw Brawl
games.tagline: Grab pearls, bank treasure and dodge the sprinklers against three computer rivals in a backyard brawl.
games.meta: Play Draw Brawl free online. Pick Coral, Inky or Shelly, grab glowing pearls, bank them at your castle and splat three computer rivals before the sprinklers come on. 2-minute rounds, works on phone and computer.
games.lead: A backyard arena full of cardboard boxes, crates and paint splats where everyone wants the same pearls. Choose Coral, Inky or Shelly, scoop up glowing pearls and carry them home to your own castle before a rival splats you. Every 25 seconds the sprinklers soak the outer lanes, so plan your route. Highest banked score after two minutes wins. You play against three computer rivals, right in your browser.
how: Pick a character. Coral is a sturdy close-range brawler, Inky is fast with rapid ink shots, and Shelly is a tank with a water shot and a shield.
Collect the glowing pearls scattered around the yard. There are plenty in the middle. You can carry up to 15.
Carry them back to your own castle and stand inside its ring for a moment to bank them. Only banked pearls count, and other players' castles won't take yours.
Bop rivals to splat them: they drop everything they were carrying and jump back in a few seconds later.
Get really close to a rival and a Showdown ring locks you both in for a few seconds. Splat them before the timer runs out to win bonus pearls.
Watch for the sprinkler warning: water soaks the marked outer lanes and slows anyone running through it. Castles stay dry.
Highest banked score when the 2-minute timer ends wins. Ties are shared.
controls: Computer: WASD or the arrow keys move. J attacks and auto-aims at the nearest rival; hold the mouse button to aim shots yourself. Space dashes, Q uses your special, Esc pauses.
Phone or tablet: drag the left side of the screen to move. ATTACK auto-aims, or drag the AIM pad to point your shots where you want them. SPECIAL and DASH are next to it.
The pause button freezes the match. The speaker button turns sound effects on; they start muted.
tips: Bank often. Pearls you're carrying are worth nothing until they're home, and a splat spills them all.
Fight rivals who are carrying a lot and let the ones with empty hands go.
Head for your castle when the sprinkler warning appears so you're not stuck in the spray.
Shelly's shield blocks every hit for a moment: pop it when two rivals close in.
Showdown wins pay 3 bonus pearls, so pick fights when your health is high.

games.name: Doodle Darts
games.tagline: Tap at just the right moment to blast the target and nail the gold sand dollar.
games.meta: Play Doodle Darts free online. A one-tap timing darts game on the beach: wait for your aim to drift over the target, throw, and blow it apart. Chain sand dollar bullseyes, dodge pufferfish and unlock new beaches and darts. Works on phone and computer.
games.lead: A fast one-tap darts game on a sunny beach. Your aim drifts left, right, up and down over a shiny target. Tap at the right moment and your dart smashes the target to pieces, then a new one pops up somewhere else. Hit the gold sand dollar for a bullseye, build combos, and see how many beach friends you can beat.
how: Watch your aim drift over the target. Tap when it's on the target to throw. Every hit is worth a point.
Hit the gold sand dollar in the middle for a Bullseye. Bullseyes in a row build a combo worth more and more points.
Miss the target and you lose a dart. You have 3. Never hit a pufferfish, or your game is over.
Smash the small bonus sand dollars when they appear for extra points and coins.
controls: Tap or click anywhere on the beach to throw. On a keyboard, press Space.
The turtle button slows your aim for 5 throws and the target button makes the target bigger for 5 throws. Each costs 25 coins.
Use the Shop on the start screen to spend coins on new beaches and new things to throw.
tips: Your aim speeds up as your score climbs, so save the Slow Tide power-up for later in a run.
Coins come from every hit, with bullseyes and bonus sand dollars paying the most.
Out of darts? Keep playing for 50 coins gives you one more dart, once per game.
Beat Gull, Crab, Clownfish and the rest of the beach friends on the way to the Whale.

games.name: Word Workshop
games.tagline: Drag across the letters to spell words and fill a beach crossword.
games.meta: Play Word Workshop free online. Drag across a ring of letters to spell words, fill the crossword, find bonus words and build combos. Choose Beginner, Intermediate or Advanced across 88 beach levels. Works on phone and computer.
games.lead: A relaxing word puzzle on a sunny beach. Drag across the letters on the wheel to spell words, and each one you find drops into the crossword above. Fill every square to finish the level. Every real word counts: extra words earn bonus points, quick words build combos, and long words make a splash.
how: Drag across the letters on the wheel to spell a word, then let go.
Words that fit the crossword drop into the board. Fill every square to finish the level.
Any other real word is a Bonus Word. It earns points and fills the Bonus meter under the board, and every 6 bonus words pays 30 sand dollars.
Find words within a few seconds of each other to build a combo, up to 5X points. Longer words score much more.

On Beginner, after five misses in a row the first two letters of an unsolved word light up as a clue (eight misses on Intermediate, no free clues on Advanced). Solve a level without hints for 3 stars.

Pick a difficulty. Beginner has 28 relaxed levels from Sand to Seashore. Intermediate has 30 levels with 6 and 7 letter wheels, bigger grids and 1.5X points. Advanced has 30 levels with 7 and 8 letter wheels, only counts words of 4 or more letters, and gives you 4 minutes plus 10 seconds per grid word, for 2X points.
controls: Drag with your finger or mouse across the letters. Slide back to the previous letter to undo it.

Shuffle mixes up the letters. The lightbulb costs sand dollars per step (10 on Beginner, 15 on Intermediate, 25 on Advanced): first it lights up a starting shell, then the next shell, then shows the word's first letters in the grid.
The star shows your bonus words and personal bests, the bars button lets you switch difficulty or start over, and the speaker button turns sound on or off.
tips: Look for short three-letter words first. They often unlock the crossing letters for longer words.
Shuffle when you feel stuck. Seeing the letters in a new order often shows you a word right away.
Try every word you can see. Real words that don't fit the grid still earn bonus points and fill the Bonus meter.
The level's name is always one of the answers, and it uses every letter on the wheel.

games.name: Bubble Doodle
games.tagline: Aim, bounce and pop bubbles before the tide rolls in.
games.meta: Play Bubble Doodle free online. Aim with a glowing guide line, bank shots off the walls and pop matching bubbles before they reach the tide line.
games.lead: A bubble shooter with a glowing aim line. Bounce shots off the walls, pop bubbles of the same color and knock loose whole clusters before the rows reach the tide line.
how: Drag to aim. The blue line shows exactly where your shot will go, including bounces off the walls.
Release to shoot. Hitting a bubble of the same color pops the whole connected group.
Bubbles left hanging with nothing above them fall off for bonus points.
Pop every bubble to clear the level. Each level only sends a few new rows, so the board can be beaten, and each level adds rows and colors. The game ends if bubbles cross the dashed tide line.
controls: Drag and release with a mouse or finger to aim and shoot.
Tap the waiting bubble to swap it with your current one.
On a keyboard, use the arrow keys to aim and Space to shoot.
Every 6 pops charges a bomb that clears everything around where it lands.
tips: Bank shots off the walls to reach gaps you can't hit directly.
Dropping a big hanging cluster is worth far more than popping.
Watch the new-row counter and clear the lowest rows first.

games.name: Four in a Frame
games.tagline: Sort sixteen beach words into four secret groups of four.
games.meta: Play Four in a Frame free online. Sort sixteen beach words into four secret groups of four. Play a new Daily Puzzle every day, or pick Beginner, Intermediate or Advanced. Works on phone and computer.
games.lead: A word-sorting puzzle for the whole family. Sixteen words wash up on the beach, and they hide four secret groups of four. Tap four that belong together and check your guess. Groups start easy, like sea animals and colours, and get sneakier as you go, with words that seem to fit two groups at once.
how: Tap four words you think belong together, then tap Check.
Get it right and the group lifts to the top in its colour. Yellow groups are the easiest and pink groups are the trickiest.
If you're one word off, it tells you you're one away. Run out of tries and the groups are shown, and you lose a shell. Lose all 3 shells and the game ends.

Pick a level. Beginner has simple groups with 5 tries and 2 hints per puzzle. Intermediate adds wordplay like WATER___ with 4 tries, 1 hint and 1.5X points. Advanced is full of red herrings, with 3 tries, no hints and 2X points. Each level remembers where you got to.

Play the Daily Puzzle from the yellow Daily button. Everyone gets the same puzzle that day, the clock only runs while you're playing, and solving one each day builds your streak. Share your result to challenge friends.
Each group you find scores points, plus a bonus for every try you had left.
controls: Tap or click a word to pick it, and tap it again to put it back.
Shuffle mixes up the words, Clear unpicks them, and Hint lights up two words that go together.
On a keyboard, press Enter to check and Escape to clear.
The Sound button turns sound on or off.
tips: Find the easiest group first. Fewer words left makes the tricky groups easier to spot.
If a word fits two groups, save it for last and work out which group needs it.
Some groups are word puzzles, like words that go before FISH or words that sound like letters.
Use Shuffle when you feel stuck. Seeing the words in a new order often helps.

games.name: Margin Match
games.tagline: Tap beach treasures off the pile and collect three of a kind in your tray.
games.meta: Play Margin Match free online. Tap glossy beach treasure tiles off a stacked pile, collect three of a kind in your 7-spot tray and clear the whole pile to win each level. Works on phone and computer.
games.lead: A cheerful tile-matching puzzle piled high with beach treasures. Tap a tile and it hops into your tray. Collect three of the same, like three crabs or three sunglasses, and they sparkle away. Clear the whole pile to win the level, but don't let your 7-spot tray fill up.
how: Tap any bright tile on the pile to move it into your tray at the bottom.
Get three of the same treasure in the tray and they clear away for points. Clear trios quickly one after another for a combo.
Dark tiles are covered by tiles on top. Clear the tiles above them first.
Clear every tile from the pile to finish the level. If all 7 tray spots fill up without a trio, the level is over and you can try it again.
Each level has more tiles, more kinds of treasure and taller stacks.
controls: Tap or click a tile to move it to the tray.

Undo puts your last tile back on the pile. Lift moves 3 tiles from your tray up to a holding spot, and you can tap them back in later. Shuffle mixes up the treasures on the pile. You get one of each every level.
The ? button shows the rules and lets you continue from your last level or start a new game.
tips: Before you tap, look at what's already in your tray and pick a tile that matches it.
Uncover the tall stacks early so the dark tiles don't trap you at the end.
Save Lift for when your tray has 5 or 6 tiles. It frees up room right away.
Your level is saved, so you can come back later and carry on.
